caption:
Today's Sky is Yin Fire, The Candle Flame 🕯️ Pause on your Day Master.

Your Day Master is the element of the day you were born. Today's small, steady flame meets it and creates one of 10 forces: Yin Fire gets a friend day, Yang Earth feels supported, Yin Metal feels a little pressure.

Don't know yours? Find it free at the link in bio.

What's your Friday line? Comment below.

#skyandseason #innerconstellation #astrology #zodiac #selfawareness #astrologer #bazi #chinesemetaphysics #fiveelements #dailyhoroscope
day_line: A candle flame on an Ox day. Warm and patient: good for careful work and kind words, easy to overthink.

lines.Yang Wood: You'll want to fix the Friday plan today. Suggest once, then go with the group.
lines.Yin Wood: Creative streak today. Doodle, cook, rearrange your desk; the inbox can wait an hour.
lines.Yang Fire: Someone wants the same last slot today. Share it; there's always another one.
lines.Yin Fire: Your kind of people are around today. Make the dinner plan before Friday fades.
lines.Yang Earth: Someone has your back today. Ask for the favour you've been putting off.
lines.Yin Earth: Quiet thinking pays off today. Take the long way home and let the answer come.
lines.Yang Metal: Your effort gets seen today. Say thanks and skip the humble-brag.
lines.Yin Metal: A small deadline pinches today. Finish it before the weekend, then switch off.
lines.Yang Water: Good money sense today. Move a little into savings before the weekend makan.
lines.Yin Water: A surprise offer could land today. Sleep on it; good deals don't vanish overnight.
